name: Lucia Nicol
source:
Lucia is a student of Valudeto High. She likes engrossing herself in studying and looks down on people who are not as intellectual as her. She only cares for her own sake and may appear snobbish at times. She is often bullied for this very reason. 

Ever since her sister's death, Lucia has been trying so hard to take her place. She believes that by doing so, she will be able to find her rightful place in the family; however, unlike Bertha, Lucia only excels at one field: academics.

She has a crush on her Senior, Raphael Martis, ever since she was young.
